scope: Real Chromium controls/canvas/workers with simulated localStorage and intercepted download blobs. No file-origin persistence or hosted service-worker certification.

results.name: Visible Via button opens controls and creates an assigned plated via
Repeated placement uses preset/tenting defaults and supports undo/redo
Unassigned empty-space vias stay visible to manufacturing checks
Placing directly on an off-grid trace snaps to its center and inherits net
Conflicting front/back nets produce a red preview and no board mutation
Board-edge and mounting-hole clashes block standalone placement
Bad annular rings and undersized drills do not change placement defaults
Inspector edits dimensions/tenting and respects the via lock
V during tracing inserts a via and continues a connected bottom-layer route
Visible layer-change button commits trace plus via as one undoable edit
Traces start/end on vias and a via remains selectable over its trace
Via routes can finish directly on an existing same-net trace
Blocked routing via leaves the trace, side and board unchanged
Manage vias table selects objects for duplication and deletion
Moving an attached via exposes disconnection instead of moving copper silently
JSON backup and actual file-input import retain via details
KiCad export explicitly warns about via mask/lock limitations
A blocked arrow-key via move rolls back without an uncaught exception
Placement, inspector and generated-file views render the actual via
Narrow-screen users can reach the visible Via tool without page overflow
No external asset requests or uncaught exceptions in via workflows
